name: research
description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture findings as a Markdown file. Delegates reading legwork to a background agent. TRIGGER: "research X", "look into Y", "find out about Z", "docs/API facts needed", "delegate this reading", or when the user wants a topic researched in depth. DO NOT USE: for simple factual lookups that don't need a written artifact, or when the user wants to do the reading themselves.
